title: Time Zones and Duration: 12- and 24-Hour Time Across Australia and the World
seo_title: Year 8 Time Zones Worksheets: 24-Hour Time, Duration and Australian Time Zones (Free, Answer Key)
standard_text: solve problems involving duration, including using 12- and 24-hour time across multiple time zones
meta_desc: Free Year 8 maths worksheets on time for the Australian Curriculum (AC9M8M04): 12- and 24-hour time, durations past midnight, Australian time zones and daylight saving, world times from UTC offsets and flight problems. 100 questions with an answer key.
key_big: Going east, clocks are ahead: add the time difference. Going west, subtract it.
key_sub: There are 60 minutes in an hour. Queensland, the NT and WA do not use daylight saving.
body_html:
How it works

24-hour time uses 00:00 to 23:59. For pm times add 12 to the hour (3:45 pm = 15:45); 12:30 am is 00:30.

To find a duration, count on to the next hour, then whole hours, then the minutes. There are 60 minutes in an hour, not 100.

Australian time zones: Western Australia (AWST, UTC+8), South Australia and the Northern Territory (ACST, UTC+9:30), and the eastern states (AEST, UTC+10). In summer, New South Wales, Victoria, Tasmania, the ACT and South Australia move forward 1 hour for daylight saving; Queensland, the Northern Territory and Western Australia do not.

Going east, clocks are ahead, so add the difference. Going west, subtract it.

Example

How long is it from 9:50 am to 2:15 pm?

9:50 to 10:00 is 10 min.

10:00 to 2:00 pm is 4 h.

Then 15 min.

Answer: 4 h 25 min

Example

In June it is 4:00 pm in Sydney. What time is it in Perth?

Perth is 2 hours behind Sydney.

Answer: 2:00 pm

Example

In January it is 9:00 am in Brisbane. What time is it in Sydney?

Sydney is on daylight saving (UTC+11) but Brisbane is not (UTC+10).

Answer: 10:00 am

Common mistakes

  • Treating time like decimals: 10:50 to 11:20 is 30 minutes, not 70.
  • Adding 12 to a morning time when changing to 24-hour time.
  • Going the wrong way: Perth is behind Sydney, so subtract.
  • Forgetting the half hour for South Australia and the Northern Territory, or forgetting that Queensland has no daylight saving.

faq.a: AWST (UTC+8) in Western Australia, ACST (UTC+9:30) in South Australia and the Northern Territory, and AEST (UTC+10) in Queensland, New South Wales, the ACT, Victoria and Tasmania.
New South Wales, Victoria, Tasmania, the ACT and South Australia. Queensland, the Northern Territory and Western Australia do not.

faq.q: How do I work out the time in another time zone?
faq.a: Find the difference between the two UTC offsets. Add it if the other place is further east (ahead), and subtract it if it is further west (behind).

faq.q: How do I find a duration that goes past midnight?
faq.a: Find the time to midnight, then add the time after midnight.

items.q: A flight leaves Perth at 9:00 am (AWST) and takes 4 hours to reach Sydney. In June, what is the local time in Sydney when it lands?
items.e: It lands at 1:00 pm Perth time. Sydney is 2 hours ahead in June: 3:00 pm.

items.q: A flight leaves Sydney at 6:00 pm and takes 5 hours to reach Perth. In June, what is the local time in Perth when it lands?
items.e: It lands at 11:00 pm Sydney time. Perth is 2 hours behind: 9:00 pm.

items.q: A cricket match in Adelaide starts at 1:30 pm (ACST, June). What time is this in Brisbane?
items.e: Brisbane is 30 minutes ahead of Adelaide: 2:00 pm.

items.q: In January, a TV show starts at 7:30 pm in Melbourne (AEDT). What time is it in Brisbane?
items.e: Queensland does not use daylight saving, so in January Brisbane is 1 hour behind Melbourne: 6:30 pm.

items.q: A bus leaves at 22:45 and arrives at 06:15 the next morning. How long is the trip?
items.e: 22:45 to 00:00 is 1 h 15 min. 00:00 to 06:15 is 6 h 15 min. Total 7 h 30 min.

items.q: A train leaves Sydney at 07:42 and arrives in Canberra at 11:56. How long is the journey?
items.e: 07:42 to 11:42 is 4 h, then 14 min more: 4 h 14 min.

items.q: In January (UTC+11), it is 8:00 pm in Sydney. London is UTC+0. What time is it in London?
items.e: London is 11 hours behind: 8:00 pm − 11 h = 9:00 am the same day.

items.q: A flight from Sydney to Los Angeles leaves at 10:00 am on Friday and takes 14 hours. In January Sydney is UTC+11 and Los Angeles is UTC−8. What is the local time when it lands?
items.e: It lands at 12:00 am Saturday Sydney time. Los Angeles is 19 hours behind: 5:00 am on Friday.

items.q: Which of these does NOT use daylight saving time?
items.e: Queensland, the Northern Territory and Western Australia stay on standard time all year.

items.q: How many hours ahead of Perth is Sydney in January (daylight saving)?
items.e: In January Sydney is UTC+11 and Perth is UTC+8: 3 hours.

items.q: A webinar starts at 4:00 pm in Brisbane. A student in Darwin (ACST) joins. What time is it in Darwin?
items.e: Darwin is 30 minutes behind Brisbane all year: 3:30 pm.

items.q: A shift starts at 21:30 and lasts 9 hours. When does it finish, in 24-hour time?
items.e: 21:30 + 9 h = 30:30, which is 06:30 the next day.

items.q: Ruby says 1.5 hours is 1 h 50 min. What is it really?
items.e: 0.5 of an hour is 30 minutes, so 1.5 h = 1 h 30 min.

items.q: How many minutes are in 3¾ hours?
A runner finishes a marathon in 3 h 47 min. She started at 06:20. When does she finish?
In June it is 12:00 pm in Melbourne. Where is it 10:00 am?
items.e: Perth is 2 hours behind Melbourne in June: Perth.

items.q: In January, Tokyo is UTC+9 and Adelaide is UTC+10:30. When it is 6:00 pm in Adelaide, what time is it in Tokyo?
items.e: Tokyo is 1 h 30 min behind Adelaide: 4:30 pm.

items.q: A ferry timetable shows departures every 35 minutes from 07:10. What is the time of the fourth departure?
How long is it from 11:40 pm Tuesday to 2:15 am Wednesday?
items.e: 11:40 pm to midnight is 20 min, then 2 h 15 min: 2 h 35 min.

items.q: A phone call between Perth (UTC+8) and New York (UTC−5) is booked for 9:00 am Monday in New York. When is that in Perth?
items.e: Perth is 13 hours ahead: 9:00 am + 13 h = 10:00 pm Monday.
